typesense:trending.greeting:
*Prime Earth never really sleeps.*

*Somewhere, Gotham drowns beneath freezing rain and neon, the Bat-Signal burning a bruised hole in the smog. Across the bay, the Daily Planet globe catches the morning sun in Metropolis as a streak of red and blue disappears into the clouds.*

*Central City hums with impossible speed. Themyscira fiercely guards ancient power, while Atlantis watches in silence from beneath miles of black water. Far beyond the atmosphere, emerald rings patrol the space between stars.*

*The Justice League responds when the planet shatters. The Titans carry their own history. A.R.G.U.S. keeps the files, Amanda Waller keeps the contingencies, and Lex Luthor builds toward tomorrow. Villains scheme and cosmic crises unfold whether anyone looks up or not.*

*And somewhere within all of it, there is you.*

*Maybe you wake up to the wail of sirens in Gotham. Maybe you step off a train into the blinding light of Metropolis. Maybe you are standing on another planet entirely.*

*You could be a hero, a villain, a rogue scientist, an alien exile, or a simple citizen. Whoever you are and wherever your story begins is up to you, this universe is just waiting for your first move.*
typesense:trending.name: Prime Earth
typesense:trending.title: Fully in depth RPG set in the world of the DC Comics Universe
